narrative.headline: 2018 Tesla Model 3: collision-avoidance and electrical issues lead owner complaints
narrative.summary: Across 975 owner complaints to NHTSA, forward collision avoidance is the most-reported area at 199 reports (20%), followed by the electrical system and suspension, tied at roughly 165 and 164 reports each (17%). Air bags account for 132 reports (14%) and seat belts for 98 (10%). Crashes and injuries show up across the top categories, and two fires were reported (one in the electrical system, one in the suspension data).

issues.title: Forward Collision Avoidance
issues.blurb: Most-reported area: 199 complaints (20%), with 24 crashes and 8 injuries reported and no fires. Owners describe cameras going black or showing a "driving visualization temporarily degraded" error and the screen becoming unresponsive.
